It is a hymn (stotra) with a commentary titled Amodrañjanī (attributed to Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī, but actually authored by Vātsya Subrahmaṇya).
This hymn is in 100 verses, divided into 5 Ullāsas. See New Catalogus Catalogorum (NCC). Vols 1–36: vol. 34, p. 85b.
